sv.title: WHO vädjar om fred i eboladrabbade landet
sv.summary: Världshälsoorganisationen WHO vädjar om fred i det eboladrabbade Kongo-Kinshasa. WHO-chefen Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus skriver i sociala medier att våldsamheterna ökat sen i oktober och att det påverkar insatserna mot ebola.

en.title: WHO calls for peace in Ebola-affected country
en.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) calls for peace in Ebola-affected Kongo-Kinshasa. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus writes on social media that violence has increased since October and that it is affecting efforts against Ebola.
